name: Star Blizzard LNK Masquerading as Document (Double Extension)
description: Detects creation of a Windows shortcut using a double extension to masquerade as a PDF or Office document (e.g. Event_Invitation.pdf.lnk) — the RedFlick initial-access lure delivered inside password-protected archives attached to event-invite phishing against think tanks and NGOs.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Weaponized LNK Creation Targeting Hidden conhost.exe Chain
description: PowerShell using the WScript.Shell COM interface (CreateShortcut) to build a shortcut targeting conhost.exe with --headless arguments and hidden WindowStyle — the construction pattern of the RedFlick lure LNK that launches a hidden cmd.exe chain without a console flash.
query: process where process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : "*WScript.Shell*" and process.command_line : "*CreateShortcut*" and process.command_line : "*conhost.exe*" and (process.command_line : "*--headless*" or process.command_line : "*WindowStyle*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Explicit conhost.exe Execution with Headless Flag
description: conhost.exe is normally spawned implicitly by the OS; an explicit conhost.exe process creation carrying --headless that spawns cmd.exe to run a script is the RedFlick no-window execution primitive launched from the malicious LNK.
query: process where process.name : "conhost.exe" and process.command_line : "*--headless*" and process.command_line : ("*cmd.exe*" or "*.bat*" or "*.cmd*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: ssh.exe PermitLocalCommand Download Cradle
description: Windows OpenSSH client invoked with PermitLocalCommand=yes and LocalCommand= carrying a download/execution command — the RedFlick ingress-tool-transfer cradle where ssh client options execute a client-side command (e.g. curl.exe MSI download) upon connect. ssh.exe is rare on endpoints; this flag surface is a strong technique signal.
query: process where process.name : "ssh.exe" and process.command_line : "*PermitLocalCommand=yes*" and process.command_line : "*LocalCommand=*"
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: System curl.exe Ingress Transfer of Payload Files
description: System32 curl.exe invoked with an output flag to write MSI/EXE/PDF/ZIP files to disk from a remote URL — the RedFlick transfer primitive used to fetch setup.msi and the weaponized invite.pdf over HTTP.
query: process where process.name : "curl.exe" and process.executable : "*\\System32\\curl.exe" and process.command_line : ("* -o *" or "* --output *") and process.command_line : ("*.msi*" or "*.exe*" or "*.pdf*" or "*.zip*" or "*.rar*") and process.command_line : ("*http://*" or "*https://*" or "*ftp://*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: PowerShell Base64 Decode and Invoke-Expression from Document
description: PowerShell reading a PDF/document from disk ([IO.File]::ReadAllText), decoding an embedded base64 blob ([Convert]::FromBase64String, cAB magic marker) and executing it via Invoke-Expression — the RedFlick July-chain execution from a weaponized PDF.
query: process where process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and process.command_line : "*FromBase64String*" and process.command_line : ("*Invoke-Expression*" or "*IEX *") and (process.command_line : "*ReadAllText*" or process.command_line : "*.pdf*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Silent msiexec Install of Package from User-Writable Path
description: msiexec.exe invoked with /i and silent flags (/q, /qn, /quiet) to install an MSI from a user-writable path with a non-standard parent process — the RedFlick MSI install step whose custom actions establish the persistence tasks.
query: process where process.name : "msiexec.exe" and process.command_line : "* /i*" and process.command_line : ("*/q*" or "*/quiet*") and process.command_line : ("*\\Users\\*" or "*\\AppData\\*" or "*\\Temp\\*" or "*\\Downloads\\*") and not process.parent.name : ("explorer.exe", "msiexec.exe", "ccmexec.exe", "TrustedInstaller.exe", "svchost.exe")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: RedFlick Persistence Task Names Masquerading as Network Components
description: Creation of the scheduled tasks disclosed for the RedFlick persistence layer using their real adversarial names — Internet Quality Test Connection, Network Configuration Manager, System Health Monitor — masquerading as network components with DAILY/ONLOGON triggers.
query: process where process.name : "schtasks.exe" and process.command_line : ("*/Create*" or "*/create*") and process.command_line : ("*Internet Quality Test Connection*" or "*Network Configuration Manager*" or "*System Health Monitor*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Scheduled Task with Logon or Daily Trigger from User-Writable Path
description: Generic behavioral layer: schtasks /Create with ONLOGON or DAILY trigger whose action points into a user-writable directory — the shape of the RedFlick persistence tasks (DAILY 09:30 and ONLOGON in user context) and of most malware installers.
query: process where process.name : "schtasks.exe" and process.command_line : "*Create*" and process.command_line : ("*/SC ONLOGON*" or "*/SC DAILY*" or "*/SC ONSTART*") and process.command_line : ("*\\Users\\*" or "*\\AppData\\*" or "*\\Temp\\*" or "*\\ProgramData\\*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Control Panel Applet Executed from User-Writable Path
description: rundll32.exe shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL (or control.exe) invoked against a .cpl file located outside System32 in a user-writable path — the CosmicPulse execution surface driven by its scheduled task, including WebDAV/UNC remote applet variants.
query: process where ((process.name : "rundll32.exe" and process.command_line : "*Control_RunDLL*") or process.name : "control.exe") and process.command_line : "*.cpl*" and process.command_line : ("*\\Users\\*" or "*\\AppData\\*" or "*\\Temp\\*" or "*\\Downloads\\*" or "*\\ProgramData\\*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: CosmicPulse Payload Staging in .mollis Registry Key
description: Writes to HKCU\Software\Classes\.mollis — the CosmicPulse downloader's staging key holding an AES-ECB-encrypted, base64-encoded payload/config that the bootstrapper later recovers and decrypts. A Classes key shaped like a benign file extension holding a base64 blob is a real campaign identifier and a fileless staging behavior.
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: curl.exe Beacon with Spoofed Browser User-Agent to Agent Poll Endpoint
description: The CosmicPulse registration/polling beacon: curl.exe invoked with an explicitly set Edge/Chrome User-Agent (-A/--user-agent) and/or GET requests to agent-poll-style paths carrying an id= parameter that encodes UTF-16LE+Base64 hostname|username profiling data.
query: process where process.name : "curl.exe" and ((process.command_line : ("*-A *" or "*--user-agent*") and process.command_line : ("*Mozilla/*" or "*Edg/*" or "*Chrome/*")) or (process.command_line : "*id=*" and process.command_line : ("*/agent/*" or "*/poll*" or "*/gate*")))
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Python Runtime and Bootstrapper Archives Staged in Update Subdirectory
description: Staging of python38.zip and bootstrapper.zip into a \bin\update subdirectory of a video-conference-app-style folder under user-writable paths — the CosmicPulse installer prep that lays a portable Python 3.8 runtime before the backdoor is dropped.
query: file where file.name : ("python38.zip", "bootstrapper.zip") and file.path : ("*\\bin\\update*" or "*\\update*") and file.path : ("*\\Users\\*" or "*\\AppData\\*" or "*\\Temp\\*" or "*\\ProgramData\\*")
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator

name: Correlated RedFlick Chain - Document Fetch to Base64 Execution to Silent MSI Install
description: Behavioral correlation of the full RedFlick July chain on one host within 30 minutes: curl.exe fetches a PDF/MSI payload, PowerShell reads that document, base64-decodes and Invoke-Expressions it, then msiexec silently installs the fetched MSI. Each stage alone is medium confidence; the sequence is near-zero false positive.
query: sequence by host.id with maxspan=30m [process where process.name : "curl.exe" and process.command_line : ("*.pdf*" or "*.msi*") and process.command_line : "*http*"] [process where process.name : "powershell.exe" and process.command_line : "*FromBase64String*" and (process.command_line : "*.pdf*" or process.command_line : "*ReadAllText*")] [process where process.name : "msiexec.exe" and process.command_line : "*/q*" and process.command_line : "* /i*"]
author: F0RT1KA Detection Rules Generator
